title: Constant functions of Fourier degree zero
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube $\\{-1,1\}^n$. If every nonzero Fourier coefficient of $f$ is supported on a set of coordinates of size at most zero, then $f$ is constant, with value equal to its Fourier coefficient at the empty set.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube
The Fourier degree of $f$ is at most zero
